entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Is there a roll limit?
entries.excerpt: No. Roll as often as you want once the reveal and the cooldown are over. There is no energy meter and no daily cap.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Can I pick a specific number?
entries.excerpt: No. There is no seed, no editor and no preset values. The game is about reacting to what comes up.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Does a companion make my rolls luckier?
entries.excerpt: No. Companions multiply the EP you earn. Your number and its badges stay the same.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Do offline rolls count?
entries.excerpt: Yes. They pay their EP and show up in your history. The only difference is that skills only charge while you are online.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Is this the official RNGdle?
entries.excerpt: No. It is an independent recreation. Credits for the original are further down.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Where is my save stored?
entries.excerpt: In your browser s localStorage. There is no account and no server. Switching browser, using private browsing or clearing the site s data deletes it. The details are in Save sync.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Can I play on two devices at once?
entries.excerpt: Yes, with Settings → Device link. The device that creates the link is the primary one and it is the one running rolls and purchases, so the two screens do not fight over the same roll. Anyone with the link can play with…

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Do skills change which badges come up?
entries.excerpt: Never. Skills affect what you earn or how long you wait, not how a number scores.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: What is needed for prestige?
entries.excerpt: Two things at the same time: half the badge collection and 30 million EP earned in the cycle.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: And the rollback?
entries.excerpt: It appears after three prestiges and it can be repeated.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: How many numbers can I store?
entries.excerpt: Three. That is the bookmark cap and it shows in the Bookmarks (n/3) chip in the interface. What matters is not the cap but how it is paid: every stored number pays the wallet skill multipliers, not only the last one.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Do companion signatures take a slot?
entries.excerpt: Yes. A signature takes a slot on the rack like any other circle. They do not sit apart and they are not free: equipping a signature spends a slot.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Is rollback locked until the third prestige?
entries.excerpt: It is hidden, which is not the same as disabled: before three prestiges it is not shown at all. When it appears, it starts from 0 EP (no starting bonus) and it can be repeated.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Do Trail and Drift change my roll?
entries.excerpt: They are the only two exceptions to the rule that companions do not touch the roll, and they do it in a bounded way: they use their own random sample. They do not modify your number or its score; they generate an…

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Do presentation settings affect what I earn?
entries.excerpt: Never. They do not change odds, EP, prices or timings. They are cosmetic by definition.

entries.title: FAQ
entries.heading: Does my save pass through a server when linking devices?
entries.excerpt: No. On static hosting the link goes over PeerJS on WebRTC and the public broker only does the handshake: the save travels device to device and never passes through it. The details are in Save sync.
